call: Simplified E-model: d = RTT/2 + 2 × jitter + codec delay; Id = .024d + .11 max(0,d−177.3); Ie_eff = Ie + (95−Ie)Ppl/(Ppl+Bpl); R = 93.2−Id−Ie_eff; MOS = clip(1+.035R+7e−6R(R−60)(100−R),1,4.5); QoE = (MOS−1)/3.5. Default codec delay 20 ms, Ie 0, Bpl 25.
game: 0.55 f(RTT;30,150) + 0.30 f(jitter;5,40) + 0.15 f(loss;0,2%). f decreases linearly from 1 to 0.
bulk: min(1, progress rate / fair expected rate). A floor violation is reported separately.
household: Device proxy = minimum of active flow proxies. Household proxy = mean of active-device proxies. Idle devices are excluded. Unknown inputs lower confidence.
fairness: Jain index = (Σx)² / (n × Σx²), computed over active-device QoE proxies. This is not a subjective experience measurement.
